disputed: Supporters argue that industry experience makes these officials effective and that Wright and Burgum were confirmed through normal Senate process (Burgum with some Democratic votes). Whether specific permit decisions were improperly influenced, rather than just sped up under a general policy, has not been established by any inspector general or court. The Public Domain reporting relies on emails obtained by the outlet.

items: Chris Wright founded and led Liberty Energy, a roughly $3 billion fracking-services company, before becoming Energy Secretary (confirmed Feb 2025). He has called the renewable transition 'lunacy' and laid out a 'nine-point plan' whose first priority is to 'get out of the way of the production, export and enhancement of our volumes of coal, oil and gas.' (ProPublica (https://www.propublica.org/article/energy-secretary-chris-wright-climate-change-double-speak-oil-gas-trump))

Doug Burgum chairs the National Energy Dominance Council. Hamm's Continental Resources gave $250,000 to Burgum's 2024 presidential campaign, and Burgum has earned up to $50,000 in royalties from Continental's drilling on family land. On April 23, 2025, Burgum met Hamm in Oklahoma City and the same day announced faster permitting on federal lands. (Public Domain (https://www.publicdomain.media/p/emails-show-interior-department-delivered-drilling-permits-hamm-continental-burgum-wyoming))

Emails show a Continental employee sent Interior officials a six-page 'roadmap' in June 2025 for getting permits approved despite a court injunction. BLM then granted Continental 71 new well permits in Converse County, Wyoming, using workarounds that avoided the vacated environmental review. (Public Domain (https://www.publicdomain.media/p/emails-show-interior-department-delivered-drilling-permits-hamm-continental-burgum-wyoming))

The Senate Democratic report counts 26 senior officials at EPA, DOE and Interior who previously worked for fossil-fuel or other polluting industries. (Senate EPW Democrats (https://www.epw.senate.gov/public/index.cfm/press-releases-democratic?ID=D17E87C8-BA5B-4D3A-BA7A-CAD03C4B6F2D))

At EPA, early picks included Nancy Beck, a former American Chemistry Council official with a history of opposing chemical-safety rules. (EHN (https://www.ehn.org/trump-shifts-epa-leadership-with-industry-aligned-appointees))

Robert Levy, a 17-year ExxonMobil senior counsel, joined DOJ's renamed Energy and Natural Resources Division as senior counsel on July 13, 2026. (Inside Climate News (https://insideclimatenews.org/news/28072026/justice-department-environmental-enforcement-has-collapsed/))
sections.label: Documentation

summary: The administration's energy policy is run by people from the industry it regulates or closely tied to it: Energy Secretary Chris Wright (a fracking CEO), Interior Secretary Doug Burgum (close to oil billionaire Harold Hamm), and more than two dozen senior EPA, DOE and Interior officials who came from polluting industries. A former ExxonMobil lawyer now sits in DOJ's environmental division.
title: Oil and gas insiders running the energy agencies: Wright, Burgum, and the appointee pipeline
